name: Isabel (2012 Games)

origin.summary: An event from the 2012 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: 30 snatches for time at a fixed barbell weight — the classic Girl WOD Isabel, reused as a Games event.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2012/8 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-10; the classic Girl WOD Isabel, reused as a Games event; contested by the top 15 athletes overall, with the top 12 finishers advancing
